Ranks all Montgomery census tracts by their 2025 code-violation count (pre-aggregated tract totals), left-joining tract names and showing zero for tracts with no recorded violations, with geoid last for mapping.
sql:
WITH tract_counts_2025 AS (
  SELECT geoid, SUM(n) AS code_violation_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_cd8304'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
    AND geoid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT t.name,
       COALESCE(c.code_violation_count, 0) AS code_violation_count,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN tract_counts_2025 c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
ORDER BY code_violation_count DESC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
